svg.aria-label: One Durable Object moves: it starts on OpenOrange on its first request or when backfill wakes it, copies its data from Cloudflare in pages, Cloudflare marks it moved if no write came during the copy, and Cloudflare then answers 503 migrator.moved. Roll back with MIGRATOR_DISABLED=true.
